title: [ingest] Duplicate detection uses a 0.6 overlap bar
summary: A task is only treated as a likely re-plan duplicate when label/summary overlap exceeds `0.6`. The threshold is tuned for high precision, so a false positive only nudges supersede while a miss is tolerated.
